exposure: Ursodeoxycholic acid (UDCA) for intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (ICP)
finding: The study found that rifampicin, when added to UDCA for the management of ICP, did not cause adverse fetal outcomes and was a useful adjunct to UDCA for severe and/or resistant ICP, helping to improve pruritus and serum bile acid levels.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in the mode of delivery between the two study groups (UDCA only vs. UDCA with rifampicin).
gest_age: Mean onset of pruritus: 30.02 weeks (group A), 26.70 weeks (group B)
Mean gestational age at diagnosis: 32.47 weeks (group A), 28.89 weeks (group B)
Mean gestational age at delivery: 37.011 weeks (group A), 35.70 weeks (group B)
birth_weight: Mean birth weight: 2,706.85 grams (group A), 2,522.67 grams (group B)
